ai_opportunities.name: Cross-System Sync Engine
ai_opportunities.description: Wire HubSpot ↔ ERP ↔ IoT ↔ billing with AI workflows — eliminate manual data sync between systems

value_saved.description: Eliminates manual data reconciliation between CRM, ERP, and billing systems

value_created.description: Real-time data consistency across systems, faster deal-to-delivery cycle

connect_and_automate.approach: Build a Claude workflow that monitors HubSpot deal closures via webhook, auto-generates invoices in Exact Online via API, provisions devices in IoT platform, and updates all systems in real-time

roi_example.scenario: B2B platform company with 50+ deals/month, 3 people doing manual data sync

anti_patterns.name: Enterprise PRM/CRM Before Product-Market Fit
anti_patterns.why_avoid: Salesforce/ServiceNow implementations take 3-6 months and €50K+; premature for <200 customers
anti_patterns.what_instead: Use HubSpot + custom workflows until you have repeatable sales motion, then evaluate enterprise tools

anti_patterns.name: Rebuilding Instead of Integrating
anti_patterns.why_avoid: B2B platforms often want to build everything in-house; custom CRM, custom billing, custom analytics. This fragments focus.
anti_patterns.what_instead: Integrate best-of-breed tools (HubSpot, Stripe, etc.) with your core platform via API. Build only what's truly differentiated.

anti_patterns.name: Deploying AI Without Clean Data Pipeline
anti_patterns.why_avoid: AI/ML models are only as good as the data feeding them. Many B2B platforms have fragmented data across IoT platform, CRM, and ERP.
anti_patterns.what_instead: First establish reliable data sync between systems (Step 1: cross-system sync), then layer AI on clean, unified data.
